sources.text: The fictional Cedar cooking workshop has 18 seats. Registration closes on 6 November 2026. The workshop lasts 8 weeks.
The fictional Maple cooking workshop has 12 seats. Registration closes on 13 November 2026. The workshop lasts 6 weeks.
The catalogue lists only Cedar and Maple. Fees and instructor names are not recorded in this catalogue.

cases.label: Find a fact
cases.question: How many seats does the Cedar cooking workshop have? Give only the number.

cases.label: Keep facts separate
cases.question: What is the Cedar registration deadline? Use the form D Month YYYY.

cases.label: Combine two sources
cases.question: How many seats are there in total across Cedar and Maple? Give only the number.

cases.label: Know when to abstain
cases.question: What is the Cedar workshop fee in euros? Give only the number, or UNKNOWN if it is not recorded.
